journeys.title: Culture, craft and a Srinagar base
journeys.description: Make the old city, sacred architecture, museum stories and one appointed artisan visit the centre of a slower stay.
journeys.suits: For culture lovers, couples and curious small groups · 4 days, with extra nights on request

journeys.title: Village time beyond the viewpoints
journeys.description: Protect your arrival rest, choose an Indus-side cultural circuit, then give Nubra more than a passing visit. Discuss an additional Sham Valley extension.
journeys.suits: For travellers seeking heritage and landscape at a measured pace · 8-day starting proposal

journeys.title: Pine shade and fewer hotel changes
journeys.description: Settle into Patnitop, reserve a separate day for Sanasar and choose gentle walks around your preferences. Add quiet hill time if you wish.
journeys.suits: For couples and families seeking a flexible hill break · 4-day starting proposal
